exceptions.bank_handling: If the same-day digital wire is still pending, 800-USBANKS may be able to edit or cancel it; once no longer pending the customer must work with the recipient; approved wires cannot be edited

exceptions.trigger: Customer not eligible for digital wires (tenure <6 months or no registered cellular device)
exceptions.customer_experience: Wire transfers option not available in digital banking; customer is directed to a branch (anyone can send domestic or international wires from a branch; appointment scheduling offered)
exceptions.resolution: Branch wire or wait for eligibility

assessment: Fully digital domestic wire with one-time recipient and purpose field; email-only status, no documented OTP/scam interstitial, discretionary coverage of unauthorized wires.
